english.title: Use a pedal cycle on a road when front / rear position lamp / retro reflector were not fitted
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a pedal cycle which was not fitted with

(A)_[a front position lamp]_
(B)_[a rear position lamp]_
(C)_[a rear retro reflector]_
(D)_[pedal retro reflectors]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 18(1) of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989 and section 91 of the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 4(3) states that lamps need not be fitted between sunrise and sunset.
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iii) See also offence wordings: H3370 and H3386.
(iv) Fixed penalty scheme may be applied
(v) A pedal cycle retro reflector was not required on pedal cycles manufactured before 1/10/1985.
